item.title: Valentine’s Day Tennis Social brings fun, friendship to Pelham Racquet Club
item.description: Love will be in the air—and on the courts—when the Pelham Racquet Club hosts its annual Valentine’s Day Tennis Social on Saturday, Feb. 14.

item.title: Calera embraces fresh style with veteran core under new coach Diogo Oliveira
item.description: Calera hopes to blend a successful veteran core with a new possession-based, on-ball style courtesy of new coach Diogo Oliveira as they seek more goal scorers and success on and off the pitch.

item.title: Briarwood Lions pick up dominant win over Shelby County in area semi-finals
item.description: The Briarwood Lions took on the Shelby County Wildcats in the semi-finals of the Class 5A, Area 8 tournament at home on Friday, Feb. 6. They came away with a dominant 60-12 win to secure their spot in the area finals.

item.title: “Suffering well”: How Montevallo’s Shamaya Smitherman found new life through a transplant miracle
item.description: For much of the past year, Shamaya Smitherman’s world was reduced to hospital rooms, dialysis machines and whispered prayers in the quiet hours of the night.

item.title: University Baptist Church to host free Valentine’s Day meal, mobile eye clinic in Montevallo
item.description: Montevallo residents will have the opportunity to receive a free hot meal—and access affordable eye care—this Valentine’s Day at University Baptist Church.
